tokens.v: EXTREME MACRO — the frame filled by the watch head and strap emerging from clear glacier ice. The case sits half-embedded, the olive canvas strap frozen mid-curve into the depth, air bubbles strung like beads through the blue around it. 100mm macro at f/4, framed 1:1 life-size, level with the crown; meltwater films the crystal and one drop swells at the case's lower lug. ALDERGATE reads in small clean painted capitals under the twelve. A fractured ice edge crosses the top-right corner out of focus, refracting the cold daylight into prisms.
